item.title: Arsenal Keep Up Pace As Chelsea, Liverpool Both Win In Premier League (roundup)
item.description: English Premier League: Arsenal assured they will retain at least a four-point lead over Manchester City and Aston Villa while piling the pressure once again on their two closest rivals with a convincing 4-0 win away to Leeds United in the English Premier League.

item.title: Pakistan vs Australia, 3rd T20I- Who will win today PAK vs AUS match?
item.description: The third and final game between Pakistan and Australia will be played at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore on Sunday.

item.title: PWL 2026: Practising With Foreign Players Helps Understand Game Better, Says Maharashtra Kesari’s Manisha Bhanwala
item.description: Pro Wrestling League: Maharashtra Kesari’s Manisha Bhanwala was named Fighter of the Match for her dominant display in the 57kg women’s category during the Pro Wrestling League 2026 semifinal against Delhi Dangal Warriors. Despite her team’s loss, the 28-year-old said the league provides invaluable exposure and learning opportunities that will help Indian wrestlers prepare for major global tournaments such as the Asian Games and the Olympics.

item.title: Delhi Capitals vs UP Warriorz Match 20, WPL 2026, Who will win today DC-W vs UP-W match?
item.description: Delhi Capitals Women and UP Warriorz Women will take on each other in the match no. 20 on Sunday at BCA Stadium.

item.title: La Liga 2025-26: Barcelona Win In Elche As Atletico Drop More Points Away From Home (round-up)
item.description: Spanish La Liga: FC Barcelona ensured they will retain their lead at the top of La Liga after a 3-1 win away to Elche as they maintained their advantage in the Spanish top division football over archrivals Real Madrid.

item.title: Tilak To Play Warm-up Matches, Sunder Looking Good, Suryakumar Yadav Gives Update Ahead Of T20 WC
item.description: T20 World Cup: Indian skipper Suryakumar Yadav has provided a positive update on Tilak Varma and Washington Sunder's availability in the upcoming T20 World Cup 2026 while speaking to the reporters in the post-match conference after India beat New Zealand by 46 runs in the fifth and final T20I match of the series at the Greenfield Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram.

item.title: Football: Riera Appointed Head Coach Of Eintracht Frankfurt Until 2028
item.description: With Albert Riera: Eintracht Frankfurt confirmed the appointment of Albert Riera as their new head coach on Saturday, handing the 43-year-old Spaniard a contract running until June 2028 as the Bundesliga club looks to reset its sporting direction ahead of a demanding phase.

item.title: He Plays The Way We Do: Ishan Kishan Backs Alcaraz In Australian Open Final
item.description: The Australian Open: India wicketkeeper-batter Ishan Kishan has backed Carlos Alcaraz to win the men’s singles final against Novak Djokovic at the Australian Open 2026, saying the young Spaniard’s attacking instincts and fearless shot-making closely resemble the way Indian cricketers approach their game.

item.title: 2026 Winter Olympics: Britain, Canada, Sweden Start As Favourites For Curling Title
item.description: Winter Olympic Games: Curling at the Milan-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics will open with the mixed doubles event on February 4 and conclude with the women's team gold medal match on February 22, spanning nearly three weeks of competition.

item.title: Usman Tariq Trolls Cameron Green After 'chucking' Gesture In Pakistan Vs Australia 2nd T20I
item.description: Pakistan Super League: Pakistan spinner Usman Tariq responded sharply on social media after Australian all-rounder Cameron Green appeared to question his bowling action during the second T20I match played at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore on Saturday.
